title: Yellow Buttery Thai Prosciutto Tom Kha
description: A buttery and aerated one-pot Thai dish featuring prosciutto, this tom kha is egg-free-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large pot, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the diced prosciutto and cook until crispy, then set aside.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter to the pot, then add the bruised lemon grass, sliced galangal, and lime leaves, and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the chicken broth, coconut milk, fish sauce, and lime juice, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix the sodium alginate with 1 cup of water to create a spherification bath.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the tom kha mixture into the spherification bath, and let sit for 1 minute to form pearls.
Remove the pearls from the bath with a slotted spoon, and add to the tom kha mixture.
Stir in the cooked prosciutto and serve hot.
Garnish with additional lime leaves and prosciutto if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
